dialogue.origin: （時間ですよね〜）
dialogue.content: (It's time, right?)

dialogue.origin: ロールプレイしませんか？
dialogue.content: Shall we do a role-play?

dialogue.origin: すみません
dialogue.content: I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: はい、どうしました？
dialogue.content: Yes, what's the matter?

dialogue.origin: 場所間違えて発言しておりましたよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: I was posting in the wrong place. My apologies. Let's get started.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Pleased to meet you as well.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。はじめに年齢性別今日話したい相談内容よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 年齢４５才　女性です。母のことについて相談です
dialogue.content: I'm 45, female. I'd like to talk about my mother.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。お母さんのことについてですね。どういった相談かもう少し聞いてもいいでしょうか
dialogue.content: Thank you. I see, it's about your mother. Could you tell me a little more about what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 母とは同居しており、私には旦那と二人の息子がいます。
dialogue.content: I live with my mother, and I have a husband and two sons.

dialogue.origin: 母が最近、家族に対して攻撃的なのです。
dialogue.content: Lately, my mother has been aggressive toward the family.

dialogue.origin: お母さんとは同居なんですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you're living with your mother.

dialogue.origin: お母さんが攻撃的になるときはどういった時が多いでしょうか
dialogue.content: When does your mother tend to become aggressive most often?

dialogue.origin: タイミングはバラバラですが、夜家族が集まっている時が多いです。
dialogue.content: The timing varies, but it’s often in the evenings when the family is gathered.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね家族が集まっている時は食事しているときですか
dialogue.content: I see. When your family is gathered, is it usually during mealtime?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。。何かと突っかかってきます。
dialogue.content: Yes... She finds fault with one thing or another.

dialogue.origin: 他の家族にはどうでしょうか例えば旦那さん等
dialogue.content: How about towards other family members, for example, your husband?

dialogue.origin: 旦那とは一度激しくぶつかり、それがきっかけで溝ができています。私たちの離婚問題にまで発展しそうになりましたが、今は私たちの関係は修復できてます。
dialogue.content: She and my husband had a major clash once, which created a rift. It almost led to our divorce, but our relationship has been repaired now.

dialogue.origin: 母は旦那さんに聞こえるように文句をいうのですが、旦那さんは聞こえないふりをしてくれています。
dialogue.content: My mother complains loudly enough for my husband to hear, but he pretends not to hear.

dialogue.origin: くろねこさんにだけ攻撃的な事がおおいのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Is she mostly aggressive only towards you, Ms. Kuroneko?

dialogue.origin: え？なんで名前出てますか？
dialogue.content: Huh? Why is my name showing up?

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 出てます
dialogue.content: It's showing.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。。
dialogue.content: Oh, I see...

dialogue.origin: 失礼でしたらすみません
dialogue.content: I apologize if that was inappropriate.

dialogue.origin: いえ、、、
dialogue.content: No, it's okay...

dialogue.origin: 私にも息子にも当たってきます。
dialogue.content: She lashes out at both me and my sons.

dialogue.origin: 旦那さんとのこと修復できてるならよかったです
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that you've been able to repair things with your husband.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お母さんに当たられるストレスで息子さんに当たってしまうこともあるんですね
dialogue.content: So, the stress from your mother lashing out sometimes leads you to end up taking it out on your sons as well?

dialogue.origin: いえ、そうじゃなくて、母が、私にも息子にも関係なく当たってきます。
dialogue.content: No, that's not it. My mother lashes out at me and my sons indiscriminately.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 大変失礼いたしました
dialogue.content: I deeply apologize for my misunderstanding.

dialogue.origin: いえ
dialogue.content: It's okay.

dialogue.origin: 今回のご相談は攻撃的なお母さんについてどう対処していくかについてでいいでしょうか
dialogue.content: So, for this session, would it be correct to say you'd like to discuss how to deal with your mother's aggressive behavior?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: お母さんについては旦那さんと話し合いされることもありますか？
dialogue.content: Do you ever discuss your mother with your husband?

dialogue.origin: もちろんしていますが、耐えるしかないね、というだけで、、
dialogue.content: Of course we do, but it just ends with him saying, "I guess we just have to endure it..."

dialogue.origin: それはお辛いですね
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: でも、私も仕事をしていますし、休みの日はゆっくりしたいのですが、母のご機嫌、顔色を伺って生活することにとても疲れています。
dialogue.content: But I also work, and on my days off I want to relax. I'm so tired of living my life constantly watching my mother's mood and expression.

dialogue.origin: 例えば別居などのお話はでたりしましたでしょうか
dialogue.content: For example, has the topic of living separately ever come up?

dialogue.origin: ゆっくりしたくても休まらないのは大変お辛いですね精神的にも
dialogue.content: It must be very taxing, mentally as well, to not be able to rest even when you want to relax.

dialogue.origin: 別居の話も出ました。しかし、この家は主人と母が二人で買った家なので、難しいです。主人はそれでも家族で出ることを考えていますが、そうすると母はどうなるのでしょうか
dialogue.content: We have talked about living separately. However, this house was bought by my husband and my mother together, so it's complicated. My husband is still considering moving out with our family, but if we do that, what would happen to my mother?

dialogue.origin: 母も、別居は避けたいようです。
dialogue.content: My mother also seems to want to avoid living apart.

dialogue.origin: 確かにお母さん一人だと大変ですよね
dialogue.content: It's true, it would be difficult for your mother to be alone.

dialogue.origin: ご実家はお近いですか
dialogue.content: Is your family home nearby?

dialogue.origin: 私のですか？実家はありますが、母がたまに戻るだけで、ほぼ空き家です。
dialogue.content: Mine? I have a family home, but my mother only goes back there occasionally; it’s mostly vacant.

dialogue.origin: お休みだけでもたまに旦那さんに甘えてゆっくり息子さんとお出かけるのもいいかなと思います。
dialogue.content: I think it might be nice to sometimes rely on your husband on your days off and go out for a relaxing time with your sons.

dialogue.origin: 空き家なんですね
dialogue.content: So it's vacant.

dialogue.origin: 旦那に甘えて息子とお出かけですか？
dialogue.content: Rely on my husband and go out with my sons?

dialogue.origin: 息子はまだ小学生ですし、下の子はまだ幼稚園で手がかかるので、ゆっくりお出かけとは行きません。
dialogue.content: My son is still in elementary school, and the younger one is in kindergarten and needs a lot of attention, so we can't really have a "relaxing" outing.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それは気軽に出かけるわけにはいかないですよね
dialogue.content: It's not so easy to just go out then, is it?

dialogue.origin: なので主人と４人で出かけることは多いのですが、晩御飯までに帰らないと帰った時に母は激怒していて、それからは手がつけられません。
dialogue.content: So, the four of us—my husband, my sons, and I—often go out together, but if we don't get back by dinnertime, my mother is furious when we return, and after that, she's impossible to handle.

dialogue.origin: 上手くお母さんとお話しできるといいですがお母さんとは仲良く過ごしたいですか
dialogue.content: It would be good if you could talk with your mother effectively. Do you want to get along well with her?

dialogue.origin: もちろん仲良く過ごしたいです。
dialogue.content: Of course, I want to get along well with her.

dialogue.origin: 大変ですね
dialogue.content: That must be difficult.

dialogue.origin: 夕飯くらいまでに帰れたらそこまでおこることはないですか
dialogue.content: If you're able to get home by around dinnertime, does she not get as angry?

dialogue.origin: その日の機嫌によりますが、遅くなるよりはマシですかね
dialogue.content: It depends on her mood that day, but I suppose it's better than being late.

dialogue.origin: お母さんの趣味などは何かありますか？
dialogue.content: Does your mother have any hobbies?

dialogue.origin: 趣味は韓流のドラマを見ることくらいです
dialogue.content: Her only hobby is pretty much just watching Korean dramas.

dialogue.origin: 共通している趣味あればより話も弾むと思ったのですが
dialogue.content: I was thinking that if you had a shared hobby, your conversations would flow more easily.

dialogue.origin: 韓流ドラマについて少し触れてみるのもいいと思います
dialogue.content: It might be good to touch on the topic of Korean dramas with her.

dialogue.origin: 母とは二人でお買い物に出る時間などを取ったり、努力しているつもりですが、母はどんどん意固地になって、蔑ろにされているように感じているみたいです。
dialogue.content: I try to make an effort, like taking time to go shopping with just the two of us, but my mother just gets more stubborn and seems to feel like she's being neglected.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 努力していて意固地にされたらどうしていいか分からなくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: When you're making an effort and she just becomes more stubborn, it's understandable that you wouldn't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: はい。私は一体、どうすればいいのでしょうか・・
dialogue.content: Yes. What on earth am I supposed to do...?

dialogue.origin: お母さんとだけではなく家族みんなで一緒に団欒で話し合うというのはどうでしょうか
dialogue.content: How about, instead of just with your mother, trying to talk things over as a whole family in a relaxed setting?

dialogue.origin: ね・・それができればいいのですが、母は主人が同じ食卓にいるのも腹が立つようで
dialogue.content: Well... that would be great if we could, but my mother seems to get angry just from having my husband at the same dinner table.

dialogue.origin: きっとお互いに話す機会もないとわからないことも多いと思ったのですが
dialogue.content: I just thought that without the opportunity to talk to each other, there are probably a lot of things that go misunderstood.

dialogue.origin: それは話し合いも難しいですね
dialogue.content: That does make having a discussion difficult, doesn't it.

dialogue.origin: もう同居を初めて７年になります。最初は主人とも仲良く過ごしていました。主人の実家を揉めたことがきっかけで、誰に対しても攻撃的になってしまいました。
dialogue.content: We've been living together for seven years now. At first, she got along well with my husband. It was after a dispute involving my husband's family home that she became aggressive towards everyone.

dialogue.origin: 逆にお母さんが普段から仲良くしているお友達などはいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: On the other hand, does your mother have any friends she gets along with regularly?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: お友達もいません。今住んでいる場所は母の居住していた場所から離れているので。
dialogue.content: She doesn't have any friends. The place we live now is far from where she used to live.

dialogue.origin: それは尚更大変ですね
dialogue.content: That makes it all the more difficult.

dialogue.origin: では逆にお母さんと一緒にお出かけはどうでしょうか
dialogue.content: Then, how about going out together with your mother instead?

dialogue.origin: お子さん旦那さんにお任せできる時があれば
dialogue.content: If there are times you can leave the children with your husband...

dialogue.origin: 一緒にお出かけをして、ストレス発散してあげると、数日は機嫌がいいです。
dialogue.content: When we go out together and she's able to relieve some stress, she's in a good mood for a few days.

dialogue.origin: 少しでもお母さんご機嫌いいようでしたら定期的に一緒にお出かけが一番お互いにストレス発散になりそうなので
dialogue.content: If it improves your mother's mood even a little, then going out together regularly seems like the best way for both of you to relieve stress.

dialogue.origin: きっとお母さんも楽しんでいると思います
dialogue.content: I'm sure your mother enjoys it too.

dialogue.origin: 今回お母さんのことで話してみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel after talking about your mother today?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。じゃあやはり私は母のために休日を過ごすのが一番なのですよね
dialogue.content: I see. So, I guess spending my days off for my mother's sake is the best thing to do, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。お母さんのことで少しでも気持ちが楽になれたなら嬉しいです
dialogue.content: Yes. I'm glad if you were able to feel even a little bit better about your situation with your mother.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: またよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.origin: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: Goodbye for now.

topic.sub: 攻撃的な母とのコミュニケーション問題
